serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: How should I provoke them?
Hobo: Can’t you think of anything on your own? Jesus…
Hobo: No wonder you ask me for help. You are actually inept! 
You: …
Hobo: How come out of the two of us I’m the homeless one? There is no justice in this world.
You: Are you done? 
You: I have an idea, be ready…
There was an article on Bang News that this riot was caused by the mayor. {{wi}}More or less…
I can use that to get these people riled up.
You: Mayor is great! He’s doing a great job!
???1: …
Huh? Some of these thugs started looking at me, but their reaction was somehow…{{wi}} underwhelming.
???1: Were you talking to us? About the mayor?
One of them asked me a question…
You: Y-yeah, you guys hate the mayor, right?
???1: Don’t know the guy to be honest. Don’t care.
???2: I think I voted for him…
You: Then why are you rioting?
???1: Cuz it fun? What are you, some police?
You: N-no…
???1: Cool then.
???1: Wanna come break stuff with us later? We are waiting for one of us to bring a screwdriver so we can open up that stupid bot over there laying in a trash can.
Fuck… 
This is going nowhere and time is running out…
I need to think of something fast, Priestbot will soon get stripped down to parts!
Hobo: Hey! That pale guy said that you are all a bunch of pussies! Let’s get him! 
???1: Say what?! And I even invited him to come with us! We will get you, you albino piece of shit!
???: Pale freak!
W-what?! I need to run!
{{punch}}This fucking hobo! He caught me off guard and now these thugs are dangerously close!
Weren’t they supposed to be slow?! They seem pretty fast to me!
I don’t know how long I can keep a pace like this! 
I-I’m… {{wi}}I’m losing strength…
{{punch}}Fuck… {{wi}} I tripped on something and fell down…
???1: Now we are going to fuck you up! Ungrateful little bastard! You hurt my feelings!
About a dozen of these thugs surrounded me…
???2: Gonna smash his head!
As they laugh, one of them is preparing a big swing with a steel pipe…
I guess it’s over…
{{punch}}ZZzapp!
???2: Ah! {{wi}} Something hit m-AaAaAaAaaaaaaAaAaAAAaaaa-!
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Revenge!
???1: Fuck! That stupid bot got loose and tased him! Let’s run!
